title.zh: Ethereum confirms Glamsterdam dates, but warns 'fake' builders could stall the chain

current_state.zh: Ethereum developers confirmed Glamsterdam testnet dates while warning that attackers could exploit free test ether and disposable builder identities to disrupt Sepolia block auctions by withholding transaction payloads.
